title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

texts.zh:
看来星系的市场范围无法承载其政治意图。苦于缺乏有效的主办地提名，最近 [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]为构建专门的交易中心而做出的努力都白费了。

泛星系贸易市场计划的支持者们旋即表明一点都不觉得尴尬，声称只要[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]认为时机成熟，他们将再次提出自己的主张。
texts.en:
It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have failed, with no valid nominations for a host site.

Proponents of the Galactic Market scheme were quick to deny any hint of embarrassment, declaring that they will make their case again whenever the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] considers itself ready.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的市场范围无法承载其政治意图，因为最近他们为形成统一的泛星系贸易市场而做出的努力都白费了。到头来，异种人备受推崇的项目连一个有效的主办地提名都没能吸引到。

计划的支持者否认这表明异星人的“合作”想法是弄巧成拙。相反，他们坚定地宣称，如果星系的成员认为时机成熟了，可以再次尝试。
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s political will has exceeded the reach of its markets, as their recent effort to form a unified Galactic Market has failed. After all was said and done, the xenos' much-vaunted project couldn't entice a single valid nomination for a host site.

Proponents of the scheme have denied that this exposes the true folly behind ideas about xeno 'collaboration'. Instead they are resolute in claims that the galaxy may try again, when its members consider themselves ready.
